bhajan.title: Allah Eshwar Terey Naam Karuna Sindhu Sai Ram

discourse.excerpt: The three are not distinct; they are one. Seva (service) is spiritual knowledge. Seva is the primary means to acquire Divine Grace.
discourse.theme: Seva is not separate from the spiritual path — it IS the spiritual path, and the surest way to acquire Divine Grace.
discourse.title: Practise what you preach

reflection: Swami dissolves the debate between the paths: the path of service, the path of knowledge, the path of the spirit are not three — they are one. Practising what you preach means letting your hands do what your mouth says. Today, close the gap in one small thing: if you say you value kindness, do one unsolicited kind act — and do it without telling anyone. That is practising what you preach. (Sri Sathya Sai Speaks, Vol 18, 17 Nov 1985)
seva_nudge: Do one good deed today with a pure heart and no desire for the fruit — help a stranger carry something heavy, or feed someone who is hungry.
